senses.gloss: ch.<cite ref="L00118">same</cite> <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 38:19">Targ. Gen. XXXVIII, 19</cite>; a. fr.—Part. <cite ref="L00079"><he>לְבִישׁ</he></cite>, <he>לָבִישׁ</he>.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 27:17">Targ. Job XXVII, 17</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 9:2">Targ. Ez. IX, 2</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Berakhot 28a:11">Ber. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>מאן דלביש מדא יִלְבַּשׁ מדא ומאן … ואנא אַלְבְּשֵׁיה</he> let him who has been invested with the priest’s cloak wear it; or shall he who is not invested say to him who has been, take off thy cloak, and I will put it on?; i.e. let us respect the hereditary office of the Nasi, v. <he>מַזֶּה</he>.
<cite ref="Ketubot 54a:21">Keth. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>לְבִישְׁתִּינְהוּ ואיכסתינהו לכוליה מנא</he> she put on all her dresses and wraps.

<cite ref="Shabbat 10b">Sabb. 10ᵇ</cite> [read:] <he>מֵילָתָא אַלְּבִישַׁיְיהוּ יקירן</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 30) cloaks are precious on those who are invested with them, i.e. a pupil likes to quote his teacher; a. fr.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 93:1">Targ. Ps. XCIII, 1</cite>; a. e.—Ber. l. c. Ms. M. <he>אַלְבְּשִׁינֵיה</he>, v. supra.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 132:16">Targ. Ps. CXXXII, 16</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 29:14">Targ. Job XXIX, 14</cite> <he>ואַלְבְּשִׁנָנִי</he> and it clothed (protected) me; a. e.—

<cite ref="Kiddushin 30b">Kidd. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>ונַלְבִּישָׁהּ ונכסייה</he> (not <he>ולבשייה</he>) and let him clothe and cover her. Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵃ top <he>אַלְבְּשׁוּנִי</he>; Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ top <he>מלבשוני</he> (corr. acc.), v. <cite ref="B00347"><he>בּוּרְדִּיקָא</he></cite>.
Tam. 32ᵃ; a. e.—Trnsf. to take hold of, seize.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 81b:14">Kidd. 81ᵇ</cite> <he>יצר אַלְבְּשָׁהּ</he> (her bashfulness in the presence of her father is a sign that) sensuality has seized her; <cite ref="Ketubot 51b:12">Keth. 51ᵇ</cite> <he>יצר אלבשה</he> passion has overpowered her (she speaks under the influence of sensual excitement).
